qr.description: Convert URLs, Wi-Fi credentials, vCards, and text to QR codes. Download as watermark-free PNG/SVG, free forever, no signup required.
qr.metaDescription: Create QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi, vCards, and text for free. No watermark, no signup, instant PNG/SVG download.
howTo: Pick the QR type from the tabs above (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, text).
Fill in the fields — the QR is generated live on the right.
Click PNG or SVG to download.
Use it on prints, business cards, posters, or KakaoTalk — anywhere.

faq.a: Yes. Free forever, no watermark, and no signup required.

faq.q: Will the QR codes I create work permanently?
faq.a: Yes. These are static QR codes — the image itself carries the data, so it'll keep working even if this site shuts down.

faq.q: What file formats can I download?
faq.a: PNG and SVG. We recommend SVG for print and PNG for digital use.

faq.q: How do I change the QR code size?
faq.a: Resize the downloaded PNG in your print software, or use SVG for unlimited resizing without quality loss.

faq.q: Why can't I make a dynamic/trackable QR?
faq.a: Dynamic QRs (click tracking, editable URL) need an external server, which means signup and paid plans. We only generate static QRs to keep the tool free and permanent.
QRs that are too small (under 2cm), printed at low quality, or contain very long text can be hard to scan. Use SVG for print and aim for at least 3cm.

faq.q: Can I customize colors or add a logo?
faq.a: This tool is black and white. Use the [QR with Logo] tool for a logo, or [QR with Center Text] to put text in the middle.

qr-wifi.description: Turn Wi-Fi name and password into a QR code so guests can connect with a single scan. Perfect for cafes, restaurants, and Airbnb hosts.
qr-wifi.metaDescription: Turn a Wi-Fi SSID and password into a QR code. One scan and guests are connected — great for cafes, shops, and rentals. Free, no watermark.
howTo: Enter the Wi-Fi name (SSID) exactly as it appears.
Enter the password and pick the encryption type (WPA/WEP/None).
Download the generated QR as PNG and print it.
Stick it on tables, walls, or menus — guests just scan with their camera to auto-connect.

faq.a: Yes. iOS 11+ and Android 10+ default cameras show a Wi-Fi connection prompt when they detect the QR.

faq.q: Can I make one for an open Wi-Fi (no password)?
faq.a: Yes — just pick 'None' as the encryption type.
The password is embedded as plain text inside the QR image. If you're sharing it publicly, consider setting up a separate guest Wi-Fi network on your router.

faq.q: What's the difference between WPA, WPA2, and WPA3?
faq.a: Most home and small-business networks use WPA2. Check your router's security mode and pick the matching one. If unsure, leave it on WPA.

faq.q: Can I use Korean characters in the SSID?
faq.a: Technically yes, but some devices won't display it correctly. We recommend English letters and numbers. If you already have a Korean SSID, give it a try first.

faq.q: Scanning works but it won't connect — why?
faq.a: Check: (1) SSID typo or wrong case, (2) password typo, (3) the SSID is 5GHz-only but your phone only supports 2.4GHz, or (4) the router is set to hide the SSID.

faq.q: What if my place has multiple Wi-Fi networks?
faq.a: Make a separate QR for each one. Putting guests on a guest network and staff on the main network is a good security practice.

qr-vcard.description: Encode name, company, phone, and email into a QR code. Scan to save the contact instantly — print on paper business cards for one-second exchanges.
qr-vcard.metaDescription: Free QR business card generator. Name, company, contact info — one scan saves it all to the phone's contacts.
howTo: Fill in name, company, job title, phone, email, and website.
The QR is generated on the right instantly.
Download as PNG and print on the back of your business card.
When someone scans it, all the info gets saved to their contacts at once.

faq.a: It's the global standard digital business card format (.vcf). All smartphones recognize it and save to contacts automatically.

faq.q: Can I include multiple phone numbers?
faq.a: This tool supports one number per card. For separate mobile/office numbers, put the main number first and add extra info in the company name field.
Yes. Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese all work fine.
Static QR codes can't be edited once printed. For info that changes often (job, contact), point the QR to your personal website and keep the latest info on that page.

faq.q: Can I include a profile photo?
faq.a: The vCard spec supports photos, but embedding one makes the QR much harder to scan. Even small thumbnails aren't recommended.

faq.q: Can I include social media links?
faq.a: Put an Instagram, LinkedIn, or blog URL in the website field. For multiple links, use a link aggregator (like linktr.ee) and use that one URL.

faq.q: Does the recipient need a special app to scan it?
faq.a: No. iOS 11+ and Android 10+ default cameras recognize vCard QRs automatically.

qr-decoder.description: Upload an image containing a QR code and it's decoded automatically. Works with Wi-Fi, URL, and vCard QRs. Use it on a PC without a camera.
qr-decoder.metaDescription: Free QR code image decoder. Recognizes URL, Wi-Fi, and vCard QRs, safely processed in your browser.
howTo: Upload an image that contains a QR code.
The contents are detected and displayed automatically.
If it's a URL, click to open. If it's text, copy it.

faq.q: Which QR types does it recognize?
faq.a: All standard QR types (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, text, SMS, location, etc.). Very blurry or tiny QRs may not be recognized.

faq.q: Does my image get uploaded somewhere?
faq.a: No. Everything is processed in your browser using the jsQR library. Nothing is sent to a server.

faq.q: Will it work if the QR is partially covered?
faq.a: Depends on the error correction level. Up to 25% of the center is often recoverable, but if the corner position markers are blocked, decoding will fail.

faq.q: Does it work on QR codes in screenshots?
faq.a: Yes. Phone screenshots or KakaoTalk images of QRs all work — just upload the image.

faq.q: Why decode a QR on a computer instead of scanning with my phone?
faq.a: Reasons: (1) Check if a QR from a stranger is a malicious URL, (2) Verify a printed QR on a PC, (3) You don't have your phone handy.

faq.q: The QR image is too blurry to decode. What now?
faq.a: If the source resolution is too low, decoding is unreliable. Re-shoot or recapture at a higher resolution. Upscaling with [image resize] won't help (it doesn't add pixel information).

faq.q: What if there are multiple QRs in one image?
faq.a: Currently only the first detected QR is shown. Crop the image to one QR at a time and upload them separately.

png-to-jpg.description: Instantly convert PNG images to JPG. Processing happens entirely in your browser — files are never uploaded. Adjustable quality, free, no signup.
png-to-jpg.metaDescription: Free PNG to JPG converter. Browser-based and safe, adjustable quality, no signup required.
howTo: Drag or click to upload a PNG file.
Adjust quality with the slider (90% recommended).
Check the result in the preview.
Click download to save the JPG.

faq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Conversion happens in your browser — files are never sent anywhere.

faq.q: What happens to the transparent background?
faq.a: JPG doesn't support transparency, so transparent areas become white. To pick a different background color, use the [image border] tool first.

faq.q: Can I batch convert multiple images?
faq.a: Right now this tool handles one image at a time. Upload them one by one.

faq.q: I heard PNG has better quality than JPG — why convert?
faq.a: For photos, JPG gets better quality per byte. Unless it's a logo, screenshot, or graphic, JPG is the more efficient choice.

faq.q: How much smaller will the file be?
faq.a: For photo-heavy PNGs, expect 50–80% size reduction at 90% JPG quality. Solid-color or logo PNGs see less difference.
JPG is fundamentally lossy, so even 100% isn't truly lossless. If you need lossless, stick with PNG or lossless WebP.

jpg-to-png.description: Convert JPG images to PNG. PNG is lossless, ideal for print and editing. Processing happens safely in your browser.
jpg-to-png.metaDescription: Free JPG to PNG converter. Lossless, safe, no signup required.
howTo: Drag or click to upload a JPG file.
Check the result in the preview on the right.

faq.q: Why is PNG bigger than JPG?
faq.a: PNG uses lossless compression, preserving every pixel. JPG is smaller for photos; PNG is better for logos and screenshots.

faq.q: Will quality lost in the JPG come back when I convert to PNG?
faq.a: No. Lost information can't be recovered. If possible, save the original as PNG from the start. PNG conversion just prevents further loss.

faq.q: Will the converted PNG have a transparent background?
faq.a: JPG has no transparency, so the white background stays white after conversion. To make a background transparent, you'll need a dedicated background removal tool.
The PNG can only be as clean as the source JPG. It just preserves what's there without further degradation.

faq.q: Can I batch convert multiple images?
faq.a: Right now this tool handles one image at a time. Upload them one by one.

webp-to-jpg.description: Convert WebP images to JPG. Solves compatibility issues when attaching to messengers or documents that don't support WebP.
webp-to-jpg.metaDescription: Free WebP to JPG converter. Fixes messenger and document compatibility issues. Safe and no signup needed.
howTo: Pick a quality level (90% is usually enough).

faq.a: A next-gen image format from Google. It's smaller, but doesn't open in some apps or older documents. Modern browsers all support it, but older Hancom Office and some messengers don't.

faq.q: Why doesn't WebP open in KakaoTalk?
faq.a: Older versions of KakaoTalk and some devices don't display WebP. Converting to JPG ensures it opens everywhere.
JPG doesn't support transparency, so transparent areas become white. If you need to keep transparency, use a PNG converter instead.
WebP to JPG involves re-encoding with some minor loss, but at 90%+ quality the difference is nearly invisible.

faq.q: Why are images from the internet often WebP?
faq.a: Google Search, Naver, and various social platforms now serve WebP by default for smaller files. 'Save as' often gives you WebP.

jpg-to-webp.description: Convert JPG to WebP to reduce file size by 30–70%. Faster page loading and better SEO scores.
jpg-to-webp.metaDescription: Free JPG to WebP converter. Up to 70% smaller files, faster page loads.
howTo: Adjust the quality (80% is visually nearly identical).

faq.a: At the same quality level, WebP files are 25–35% smaller than JPG. At 80% quality, the visual difference is barely noticeable.

faq.q: Does it display in older browsers?
faq.a: 99% of modern browsers support it (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Only IE doesn't — and IE is already end-of-life.
Yes. Google uses page speed (LCP) as a ranking signal, so smaller images help directly. That said, content quality still matters more.

faq.q: Does it work with WordPress or Tistory?
faq.a: WordPress 5.8+ supports it natively. Tistory and Naver Blog also accept uploads. Some older themes may not be fully compatible.

faq.q: Can I convert transparent PNGs to WebP?
faq.a: This tool is JPG to WebP only. PNG to WebP is even more beneficial because WebP supports transparency and lossless mode (use a separate tool).

image-compress.description: Shrink photo file sizes by 80%+ with minimal quality loss. Perfect for email attachments, forum uploads, and messenger sharing.
image-compress.metaDescription: Free image compressor. Up to 80% size reduction with minimal quality loss, safely processed in your browser.
howTo: Upload your image (JPG, PNG, or WebP).

faq.q: Will the original quality be lost?
faq.a: Compression is lossy. Your original file stays untouched — if you don't like the result, just bump the quality up and try again.
PNG is lossless, so the gains are minimal. To significantly shrink a PNG, convert to JPG or WebP.

faq.q: Can I batch compress multiple images?
faq.a: Currently one image at a time. For multiple, use the [image batch] tool or upload them sequentially.

faq.q: What quality level should I use?
faq.a: For web and messenger use, 70–80% looks nearly identical with files cut by more than half. For print or archive, 90%+ is recommended.

faq.q: My photos exceed the 25MB email attachment limit.
faq.a: Compressing or resizing (under 1920px wide) usually solves it. If not, zip the files or share a cloud link.

faq.q: Will transparency be lost in PNGs?
faq.a: PNG-to-PNG compression preserves transparency. But converting to JPG or lossy WebP will fill transparent areas with white.

image-resize.description: Resize images to any pixel dimensions. Auto-keeps aspect ratio, preserves quality, free, no watermark.
image-resize.metaDescription: Free image resizer. Adjust width/height in pixels, aspect ratio preserved, instant download.
howTo: Enter the desired width or height in pixels (ratio is locked by default).

faq.q: Can I ignore the aspect ratio?
faq.a: Yes — uncheck 'keep ratio' to freely resize. Just note the image may look stretched.
No. Upscaling makes pixels blurrier. Always start from the largest original you have and scale down.
Instagram square: 1080×1080, story/reel: 1080×1920, Facebook cover: 1640×859, KakaoTalk profile: 500×500.
Yes — smaller dimensions mean smaller files. For more aggressive savings, chain with the [image compress] tool.

faq.q: How do I match an exact aspect ratio?
faq.a: If you need a specific aspect ratio, the [image crop] tool is more precise. This tool only scales while preserving the ratio.

faq.q: Can I make an image larger than the original?
faq.a: You can, but pixels will be stretched and look blurry. For real upscaling, use a dedicated AI upscaling tool.

video-to-gif.description: Convert MP4, MOV, WebM videos to animated GIFs. Adjustable FPS, size, and length. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
video-to-gif.metaDescription: Free video to GIF converter. MP4/MOV/WebM supported, adjustable FPS/size/length, safe browser-based processing.
howTo: Drag or upload a video file.
Adjust FPS, width, and max length with the sliders.
Click Start — ffmpeg.wasm builds the GIF (first run downloads ~25MB of libraries).

faq.q: My GIF file is too big — what now?
faq.a: Lower the FPS to 10 or below and reduce the width to around 320px. Videos with lots of colors produce bigger GIFs.
Technically yes, but GIF files balloon past 30 seconds. Stick to under 30 seconds. For longer clips, GIF-to-MP4 is a better fit.

faq.q: Can I make a transparent GIF?
faq.a: Videos don't have transparency, so the result is a regular opaque GIF.
It's the ffmpeg video processing library compiled to WebAssembly so it runs right in your browser. The first run downloads the library (~25MB); after that it's cached.
GIF is limited to 256 colors, so the result looks simpler than the source video. If quality matters, share the original MP4 or WebM instead.

faq.q: How do I make a light GIF for KakaoTalk?
faq.a: Try FPS 10, width 320px, length 3–5 seconds. That produces a small GIF that uploads cleanly.
GIFs are silent. If you need sound, share the original video or compress it with the [video compress] tool.

video-to-mp3.description: Extract audio from videos like MP4 and save as MP3. Useful for lectures, interviews, and music videos. Processing happens in your browser.
video-to-mp3.metaDescription: Free video to MP3 extractor. MP4/MOV/WebM supported, selectable bitrate.
howTo: Pick the bitrate you want (192kbps recommended).

faq.q: Can I convert a YouTube video?
faq.a: You'll need to download the video file first. Converting copyrighted content is your own responsibility.
128kbps for speech and lectures, 192–320kbps for music. Higher = larger file.

faq.q: Can I export to formats other than MP3?
faq.a: Currently MP3 only. For AAC/WAV/FLAC, you'll need a different converter.

faq.q: Can I pick stereo or mono?
faq.a: The output matches the source's audio channels. Mono source = mono MP3.

faq.q: Does it work with large files?
faq.a: Files over 1GB may fail due to browser memory limits. For long videos, trim them first with [video trim] and extract in segments.

faq.q: Can I extract from multiple files at once?
faq.a: One file at a time. Extract each, then merge them with [audio merge] into a single MP3.

video-compress.description: Reduce video file size by 50–80% with minimal quality loss. Solves upload size limits on messengers, email, and forums.
video-compress.metaDescription: Free video compressor. Cut MP4 size by up to 80%, selectable quality, safe browser-based processing.
howTo: Pick a compression level (Medium / CRF 28 is the usual sweet spot).
Click Start. It can take a few minutes depending on length.

faq.a: CRF 28 is the standard 'visually indistinguishable' level. If you want sharper output, pick CRF 23.

faq.q: Does it work with large files?
faq.a: Browser memory caps things at around 1GB. For reliable runs, keep files under 500MB.
Constant Rate Factor — the standard quality dial for video compression. Lower = better quality, larger file. Typical values: 18 (visually lossless), 28 (standard), 35 (heavy compression).

faq.q: Processing is taking forever — how do I speed it up?
faq.a: Expect 1–3x the video length. Trim to just the part you need with [video trim] first, then compress.
Default settings compress audio sensibly with almost no audible difference unless it's music.

faq.q: Still over the 300MB KakaoTalk limit even after compressing?
faq.a: Drop the resolution to 720p or 480p with [video resize], or split the video in two.

video-trim.description: Cut out the section of a video you want. Set start and end points with sliders. Lossless fast cutting (stream copy method).
video-trim.metaDescription: Free video trimmer. Extract a section without quality loss, safely processed in your browser.
howTo: Drag the start and end sliders to pick the segment.
Use Preview to confirm the exact timing.

faq.a: No. It uses stream copy, so there's no quality loss and it's fast. But cuts snap to keyframes, so the start point may be slightly off.

faq.q: Can I cut multiple segments at once?
faq.a: Currently one segment at a time. Cut each separately, then combine them with [video merge].
Keyframe positioning may shift the cut by 0.5–2 seconds. For exact cuts, use a professional editor with re-encoding (DaVinci Resolve, etc.).
Video trimming includes the audio for the same segment. To work with audio alone, run [video to MP3] first, then [audio trim].

faq.q: Why is the output file the same size as the original?
faq.a: Stream copy preserves the bitrate without re-encoding. To shrink the file further, follow up with [video compress].

faq.q: Does it work with MOV, MKV, or AVI?
faq.a: MP4 and WebM are primary; MOV usually works. MKV/AVI depend on codec.

hwp-viewer.description: Open .hwp and .hwpx files directly in your browser — no Hancom Office required. Page navigation and zoom supported. Files never leave your device.
hwp-viewer.metaDescription: View HWP and HWPX files for free without Hancom Office. In-browser, safe, no signup.
howTo: Drag or click to upload a .hwp or .hwpx file.
Flip through pages and zoom in/out as needed.
To save as PDF, use the [HWP to PDF] tool.
If you only need the text, [HWP to text extractor] is more convenient for copy/paste.

faq.q: Does it really work without Hancom Office?
faq.a: Yes. It uses the open-source @rhwp/core (Rust + WebAssembly) engine to parse .hwp/.hwpx directly in your browser. No Hancom Office install needed.
HWP 5.0+ binary format and HWPX (KS X 6101 standard). Legacy HWP 3.0/97 use a different structure and aren't supported.

faq.q: Are files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Parsing and rendering happen entirely in your browser — nothing is transmitted. Safe even for confidential documents.
Body text, tables, images, headers/footers, and formulas mostly render correctly. Some special shapes, macros, or Hancom-exclusive fonts may look different.

faq.q: Does it work on macOS or Linux?
faq.a: Yes. Hancom Office is Windows-centric, but this viewer runs in any browser — macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, all the same.

faq.q: Can I open files on mobile?
faq.a: Yes, mobile browsers (Android/iOS) work. Files over 100 pages may be slow due to memory limits, so a desktop is recommended for big files.

faq.q: I uploaded a file but it won't open — why?
faq.a: Likely causes: (1) HWP 3.0/97 legacy format, (2) corrupted file, or (3) password-protected. If it opens in Hancom Office, try 'Save As' to the latest .hwp/.hwpx and retry.

hwp-to-text.description: Extract body text from Korean HWP documents as .txt. Useful for pasting into messengers, email, or translators. Safe browser-based processing.
hwp-to-text.metaDescription: Free HWP/HWPX text extractor. Download as .txt or copy to clipboard. No Hancom Office required.
howTo: The body text is extracted automatically and shown in the preview.
Click 'Copy all' to copy to the clipboard, or download as a .txt file.
Paste into a translator, ChatGPT, or email and you're done.

faq.q: Does it extract text from tables?
faq.a: Yes. Table cells, headers/footers, and footnotes are all extracted.
Images and shapes themselves aren't extracted (they're not text). But text typed inside shapes is included.
Each paragraph in the source becomes a line break. Pages are separated by a blank line.
No. This tool extracts plain text, so all formatting is stripped. If you need formatting, use the [HWP to PDF] tool instead.

faq.q: Can I use the result with ChatGPT or a translator?
faq.a: Yes. The output is plain text, so any AI or translation service handles it fine, including mixed Korean/Hanja/English content.

faq.q: Does it work on password-protected HWP files?
faq.a: Currently no. Remove the password in Hancom Office first, then try again.

hwp-to-pdf.description: Convert Korean HWP documents to PDF instantly — no Hancom Office needed. Perfect for sharing or printing.
hwp-to-pdf.metaDescription: Free HWP/HWPX to PDF converter. No Hancom Office required, safe browser-based processing, no signup.
howTo: Click Save as PDF — all pages are merged into one PDF.
For further processing, try [PDF merge], [PDF crop], or [PDF watermark].

faq.a: Body text, tables, headers/footers, and formulas are mostly preserved. Some special shapes or Hancom-exclusive fonts (like HY Sinmyeongjo) may be substituted with similar fonts.
Tens of pages convert without issue on a typical PC. 100+ pages may take a while — keep the browser open and wait.
No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser. Even HR/legal/contract documents stay safe.

faq.q: Why does the converted PDF look slightly different from Hancom Office?
faq.a: If a Hancom-specific font isn't embedded, the system substitutes a similar font, which can slightly change line spacing or letter width. Print results are usually fine.

faq.q: Can I use the result for government submissions?
faq.a: Yes for standard PDF submissions. Some agencies require PDF/A (archival standard) — check the submission guide.

faq.q: Can I batch multiple HWPs into one PDF?
faq.a: This tool converts one file at a time. To merge multiple PDFs, follow up with [PDF merge].

hwp-to-hwpx.description: Convert legacy .hwp files to the Korean government standard .hwpx format (KS X 6101). Useful for public-sector submissions and modern tool compatibility.
hwp-to-hwpx.metaDescription: Free HWP to HWPX (Korean national standard) converter. Good for government submissions, collaboration, and archival.
howTo: Click Convert — it generates an HWPX (ZIP+XML) package.
Open it directly in Hancom Office 2018+, or preview in compatible collaboration tools.

faq.a: The new standard format for Korean documents (KS X 6101). It's XML+ZIP based — much like OOXML (.docx) — so it works well with other tools. It's the adopted standard for Korean government documents.
Main content like body text, tables, formatting, and images is preserved. Some Hancom-exclusive features (macros, certain shape effects) may be lost.

faq.q: Does the reverse (HWPX to HWP) work?
faq.a: Currently only HWP to HWPX. HWPX is the standard and is opened directly by Hancom Office and most viewers, so the reverse is rarely needed.

(1) Government and public bidding documents often require this standard format, (2) the open structure means OneDrive, Google Drive, etc. can preview and search inside, (3) safer for long-term archival.

faq.q: Which Hancom Office versions can open HWPX?
faq.a: Hancom Office 2018 (NEO+) and later natively support HWPX. Older versions (2014 and below) need a separate converter.

faq.q: The file size changed after conversion — is that normal?
faq.a: Yes. HWPX is ZIP-compressed XML, so it can be slightly smaller or larger than the .hwp. Content is the same.

hwp-editor.description: Write text and pick a font and size, then save as a Korean-standard HWPX file (KS X 6101) — no Hancom Office required. Useful on machines without a Hancom license.
hwp-editor.metaDescription: Free HWPX editor. Type, pick font and size, save as .hwpx. No Hancom Office required.
howTo: Pick a font (Hamchorombatang, Malgun Gothic, Nanum Gothic, etc.) and a font size (pt).
Open the downloaded .hwpx in Hancom Office 2018+ or a compatible viewer.

faq.q: Which Hancom Office versions can open it?
faq.a: Hancom Office 2018 (NEO+) and later support HWPX natively. Older versions (2014 and below) need a separate converter.

.hwp is a proprietary Hancom binary that's hard to generate externally. .hwpx is the open government standard (KS X 6101), XML+ZIP-based, so it can be safely generated. Hancom Office handles .hwpx perfectly.

faq.q: Can I add tables, images, or rich formatting?
faq.a: This is a minimal generator — body text + font + size only. For tables, images, or complex formatting, open the generated HWPX in Hancom Office and edit there.

faq.q: Can I type any font name?
faq.a: Yes. You can pick a preset or type your own. The font must be installed on the computer that opens the file, otherwise Hancom will substitute a similar one.

faq.q: How do I make multiple paragraphs?
faq.a: Hit Enter in the body. Each line becomes its own paragraph in the saved file.
No. HWPX is packaged in your browser with JSZip — nothing is sent. Safe for HR, legal, or contract documents.

faq.q: I need richer editing — what should I do?
faq.a: For markdown-style rich content, try [markdown + math] and export to PDF, or build a Word file and convert in Hancom.

car-tax.description: Compute annual Korean car tax and local education tax from engine displacement and vehicle age. Supports sedans, business vehicles, hybrids, and EVs.
car-tax.metaDescription: Free Korean car tax calculator. Engine size, vehicle age, business/hybrid/EV — 2026 rates.
howTo: Pick a vehicle type (regular / hybrid / EV).
Enter the engine displacement (cc) and the vehicle age (years).
See your annual car tax and the half-year payment.

faq.a: Starting from year 3, car tax is reduced by 5% each year, up to a maximum 50% reduction for vehicles 12+ years old. A benefit for owners of older cars.

faq.q: Why is there an extra Local Education Tax?
faq.a: 30% of the car tax is automatically added as Local Education Tax. It's billed together — no separate filing required.

faq.q: Why is EV tax a flat 130,000 won?
faq.a: EVs have no engine displacement, so a flat 130,000 won/year applies regardless of model. It's an eco-friendly vehicle benefit.

faq.q: How long does the 50% hybrid reduction last?
faq.a: The 50% hybrid reduction is in effect as of 2026. Policies can change — check with your local government for updates.

faq.q: Why is the business-use rate lower?
faq.a: Business vehicles (taxis, rentals) are classified as commercial assets and get a lower rate than personal sedans.

faq.q: Is there a discount for paying annually?
faq.a: Yes — paying the full year in January gives about a 10% discount. This tool doesn't apply it; multiply by 0.9 if you do.

severance-pay.description: Estimate Korean statutory severance pay from tenure, average wage, bonus, and unused leave. Useful before resignation, retirement, or comparing DB vs DC pension schemes.
severance-pay.metaDescription: Free Korean severance pay estimator. Daily average wage × 30 days × years of service.
howTo: Enter your average monthly wage over the last 3 months before leaving.
(Optional) Enter bonuses and unused leave pay.

faq.q: Is severance paid for less than a year of service?
faq.a: Under Korea's Labor Standards Act, severance is mandatory only for 1+ years of service. Under 1 year is up to company policy.

faq.q: How is the average wage calculated?
faq.a: Total wages received in the 3 months before leaving ÷ total days in that period. Bonuses count at 3/12 ratio, unused leave pay at 3/12.

faq.q: Average wage vs ordinary wage — which applies?
faq.a: Whichever is higher. Roles with lots of night/holiday work usually have a higher average wage; roles with mostly base pay may have higher ordinary wage.
This tool shows pre-tax amounts. Retirement income tax in Korea includes a years-of-service deduction, so it's lower than regular income tax. Check Hometax for accurate net amounts.

faq.q: What about DB vs DC retirement pensions?
faq.a: DB follows this same calculation. DC is based on annual employer contributions + investment returns, so results vary by plan type.

faq.q: How do I get an exact figure?
faq.a: Ask your HR team or use the Ministry of Employment & Labor's official calculator. This tool is for quick estimates.

income-tax.description: Estimate Korean comprehensive income tax from gross income, expenses, and deductions. For May tax-filing season self-checks, freelance/rental income estimates.
income-tax.metaDescription: Free Korean comprehensive income tax calculator. Progressive rates, 8 brackets, 2026 rules.
howTo: See computed tax and total payable including local income tax.

faq.a: Rates range from 6% (up to 14M won) to 45% (over 1B won) across tax brackets. The tool subtracts the cumulative deduction automatically.
If you only have salary income and your employer handled withholding and year-end settlement, no separate filing is needed. You'll file if you have additional business, rental, or investment income.
Simplified — complex items like wage deductions or tax credits (child, donation, education) aren't fully applied. Use Hometax or a tax advisor for actual filing.
Marginal rate is the rate in the highest bracket you hit; effective rate is (total tax ÷ total income). For example, 50M won income with a 15% marginal rate often has an ~9% effective rate.

faq.q: What if I miss the May filing?
faq.a: Failing to file when required triggers late penalties (20%+ non-filing penalty) plus interest. When in doubt, contact a tax office or Hometax.
An additional 10% of the calculated tax is added as local income tax. This tool includes it in the final amount.

stt.description: Convert speech to text via your microphone. Korean / English / Japanese / Chinese supported. Great for meetings, interviews, lecture notes, and pronunciation practice.
stt.metaDescription: Free speech-to-text in Korean/English/Japanese/Chinese, powered by the browser's built-in Web Speech API.
howTo: Click the mic button and grant microphone permission.
Start speaking — text appears in real time.

faq.q: Which browsers support Web Speech API?
faq.a: Works well in Chrome, Edge, and Safari (partial). Firefox isn't supported. Mobile Chrome works too.

faq.q: Can I upload a recorded file?
faq.a: This tool handles live microphone input only. For uploaded recordings, use a server-based tool like the Whisper API.
Mic quality, background noise, speech speed/pronunciation, and technical terms all affect accuracy. Speak slowly and clearly for best results.

faq.q: Does my voice get sent somewhere?
faq.a: Chrome sends to Google servers; Safari sends to Apple. The browser doesn't process locally — voice data is sent to the provider. Be careful with sensitive content.
Some browsers do, but Korean rarely. You can edit afterwards or speak punctuation explicitly ('comma', 'period').
Web Speech API generally needs an internet connection. For offline STT, look at dedicated apps.

ocr.description: Extract text from images using Tesseract.js with Korean model support. Digitize receipts, book pages, screenshots, business cards, and more.
ocr.metaDescription: Free image OCR. Korean/English/Japanese text extraction with Tesseract.js, in-browser processing.
howTo: Pick a language (Korean / English / Korean+English / Japanese, etc.).
Copy the recognized text or save as .txt.

faq.a: High-resolution printed Korean documents: 90%+ accuracy. Handwriting, tilted photos, or low resolution drop to 50–70%. Confidence scores are shown alongside results.

faq.q: Why is it slow the first time?
faq.a: It downloads the Korean training data (~10MB) on first use. Subsequent runs are cached and much faster.

faq.q: Can it extract text from PDFs?
faq.a: Not directly. Convert with [PDF to images] first, then OCR. For digital PDFs, [PDF text extract] is more accurate than OCR.
One at a time for now. Bulk OCR is slow in-browser, so desktop tools are better.

faq.q: Does it support Hanja or Japanese?
faq.a: You can pick Japanese, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese models. For Hanja, the Japanese or Chinese model usually works best.
No. Tesseract.js runs in WebAssembly inside your browser — image and result both stay local.

faq.q: What kinds of images OCR well?
faq.a: (1) Text 12pt or bigger, (2) clear contrast between background and text, (3) shot straight on, (4) no blur. For books, lay the page flat and shoot from above.

pdf-unlock.description: Unlock password-protected PDFs (PDFs you own or have rights to). Removes edit/print/copy restrictions; supplying the correct password unlocks open-restricted files.
pdf-unlock.metaDescription: Free PDF unlock. Open password-locked PDFs, pdf-lib based, processed in your browser.
howTo: Enter the password if you know it, otherwise leave blank.
If it succeeds, download the unlocked PDF.

faq.q: Can I unlock without the password?
faq.a: PDFs with only edit/print/copy restrictions (owner password) can sometimes be bypassed, but user passwords that block opening require the actual password.
No. This tool doesn't crack passwords. It's intended for legitimate unlocking of PDFs you own.
The pdf-lib library has limits, so some strong encryption can't be processed. Use Hancom Office or Adobe Acrobat's built-in unlock feature for those.
Only process files you own or have a legitimate right to unlock. Unlocking someone else's PDF without permission may violate copyright or computer access laws — responsibility rests with the user.
No. The original stays intact and only a new unlocked copy is downloaded.

faq.q: Is the file sent to a server?
faq.a: Everything is processed in your browser — neither the PDF nor the password is transmitted.

real-estate-tax.description: Compute Korean acquisition, transfer, and property taxes — single vs multi-home, holding period, capital gain progressive rates, and standard-value property tax.
real-estate-tax.metaDescription: Free Korean real estate tax calculator. Acquisition, transfer, property tax — single/multi-home, 2026 rules.
howTo: Pick the tax type tab (acquisition / transfer / property).
Enter house status, price, and holding period.
See main tax, local education tax, special rural tax, and total.

faq.a: Single home under 600M won: 1%; 600M–900M: 2%; over 900M: 3%. Multi-home: 8–12%. Non-residential (commercial, officetel): flat 4%.

faq.q: When is the 1-home transfer tax exemption available?
faq.a: Single-household, single-home with 2+ years of ownership, under 1.2B won. Adjusted areas also require 2 years of residence. This tool is a simplified estimate.
Starts at 6% from year 3 and accumulates yearly, reaching 30% at 15 years. For single-household single-home, special enhanced deductions apply (residence + ownership combined, up to 80%).

faq.q: Property tax vs. comprehensive real estate tax?
faq.a: Property tax is levied by local governments on every home. Comprehensive real estate tax adds on top once public assessed value exceeds 900M won (1.2B for single-home owners). Computed separately.

faq.q: Can I submit this result as-is?
faq.a: These are estimates. Adjusted areas, first-time buyer, heavy tax exceptions, and temporary 2-home rules are many — check Wetax/Hometax or a tax advisor for actual filing.

faq.q: Where can I find the assessed value?
faq.a: Korea's official property price portal (realtyprice.kr) or Government24. Usually 70–80% of the actual transaction price.

youtube-thumbnail.description: Enter a YouTube video URL or ID to download the auto-generated thumbnail in 5 resolutions (max / standard / high / medium / default).
youtube-thumbnail.metaDescription: Free YouTube thumbnail downloader. Paste URL or ID, get 5 resolutions, instant save.
howTo: Enter a YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.
Click the download button for the size you want (5 resolutions available).

faq.a: youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtu.be/..., youtube.com/shorts/..., youtube.com/embed/... — all supported. You can also paste just the 11-char video ID.
The uploader may not have provided a 1280×720+ thumbnail, or it's an older low-res video. In that case, sddefault (640×480) is the largest available.
Yes. Shorts URLs are auto-detected. Since Shorts are vertical, the thumbnail may appear cropped to landscape.
Use for your own uploads or legitimate purposes (quotation, education, criticism). Commercial use of others' thumbnails without permission infringes copyright.

faq.q: Are images sent through this site?
faq.a: Thumbnails are fetched directly from the YouTube CDN (i.ytimg.com). The URL you enter isn't transmitted to any other server.

subtitle.description: Convert between SRT and VTT subtitle files and shift timing by an offset to fix sync. Extract plain text too.
subtitle.metaDescription: Free subtitle converter. SRT ↔ VTT, timing offset, plain-text extraction.
howTo: Paste subtitle text or upload an .srt/.vtt file.
Adjust the time offset (in seconds) if needed.
Pick the output format (SRT/VTT/TXT) and download.

faq.q: What's the difference between SRT and VTT?
faq.a: SRT is the older standard (movies/DVDs); VTT is the web standard (HTML5 video, supports styling). Both have similar structure — they differ in the separator (comma vs. period) and header (WEBVTT).

faq.q: Subtitles are ahead/behind the video. How do I fix it?
faq.a: Enter +1.5 (delay 1.5s) or -2.0 (advance 2s) as the time offset. All subtitle timings shift in bulk.

faq.q: How do I extract just the text?
faq.a: Pick TXT as the output. Timing info is stripped and only the dialogue is kept. Handy for ChatGPT or translators.

faq.q: Can I edit the subtitles directly?
faq.a: Yes — edit the text on the left and the output updates instantly.
Thousands of lines process instantly. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is transmitted.

faq.q: What about ASS or SSA subtitles?
faq.a: Currently SRT/VTT only. ASS/SSA carry styling info and need a different converter.

color-palette.description: Generate 5-color palettes by harmony rule — monochrome, analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic. Click to copy HEX.
color-palette.metaDescription: Free color palette generator. Harmony rules — complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic. Click to copy.
howTo: Pick a harmony rule (random / monochrome / analogous / complementary / triadic / tetradic).
Click 'Generate' until you find one you like.
Click any swatch to copy its HEX code.

faq.a: Monochrome: shades of one color. Analogous: within 30 degrees on the wheel. Complementary: opposite colors. Triadic: 120 degrees apart. Tetradic: 90 degrees apart.
Analogous is easy and harmonious. Complementary is great for emphasis but can feel garish if misused. Triadic and tetradic are good for balanced, colorful designs.

faq.q: How does this compare to Adobe Color?
faq.a: Adobe Color has more precise controls and image-based extraction but requires signup. This tool is for quick inspiration, no signup needed.

faq.q: Can I anchor to a brand color?
faq.a: This tool is random-only — no fixed base color option. To extract a color from an image, pair with [color extract].
This tool focuses on aesthetic harmony. For text/background contrast checks, use [WCAG color contrast].

faq.q: How do I use the result as CSS variables?
faq.a: Copy the HEX values into :root { --color-1: #...; } to apply across your site.

hanja-dict.description: Look up ~170 common hanja with Korean reading, meaning, stroke count, and Korean Hanja Proficiency Test grade.
hanja-dict.metaDescription: Free Hanja dictionary. Reading, meaning, stroke count, and Korean Hanja Proficiency grade (8th–3rd).

faq.a: Stroke counts can vary by ±1 between Korean/Chinese/Japanese conventions. We follow the Korean Hanja Proficiency standard.

video-editor.description: Trim, rotate, flip, change speed, mute, resize, and compress in a single tool. Combine multiple edits in one ffmpeg.wasm pass to minimize quality loss.
video-editor.metaDescription: Free all-in-one video editor. Trim, rotate, speed, mute, resize, compress — all in one ffmpeg.wasm pass.
howTo: Pick the edits you need (trim, rotate, speed, resolution, mute, compress).

faq.a: Trim, rotate (90/180/270, horizontal/vertical flip), change speed (0.25–3x), mute, change resolution (240p–1080p), and compress (CRF 18–33). Multiple operations can stack.

faq.q: Does stacking operations hurt quality more?
faq.a: Actually less. Running separate tools means re-encoding multiple times; this single tool finishes everything in one ffmpeg pass, minimizing loss.

faq.q: What if I just need one operation?
faq.a: The individual tools ([video trim], [video rotate], [video compress], etc.) still exist with simpler UIs.

faq.q: What about format conversion, merging, or GIFs?
faq.a: This tool focuses on single-video editing. For MP3/GIF conversion, merging, or info inspection, use the dedicated tools ([video to MP3], [video merge], [video info]).
Operations that need re-encoding (everything except trim) take 1–2x the video length. Trim alone uses stream copy and is very fast.

faq.q: Why is the first ffmpeg.wasm download slow?
faq.a: First run downloads the ffmpeg.wasm core (~25MB). After that, it's cached and runs immediately. Everything happens in your browser — videos are never transmitted.

pomodoro.description: 25-min focus + 5-min break cycles for productivity. Long break every 4 cycles, sound + browser notifications, cycle statistics.
pomodoro.metaDescription: Free Pomodoro timer. 25/5 cycles, notifications + stats, browser-safe.
howTo: When time's up, a notification fires and it auto-moves to the next phase.

faq.a: Named after the tomato-shaped kitchen timer ('pomodoro' in Italian). The basic cycle is 25 minutes of focus + 5 minutes of rest, balancing concentration and breaks.
Research suggests average sustained focus is around 25–30 minutes. A short, clear target lowers the barrier to starting. Adjust the duration to your pace.
Check that you allowed browser notifications (a permission prompt appears on first start). Audio still plays even if the tab is in the background.

faq.q: Does it stop if I close the tab?
faq.a: Yes — it's browser-based. Keep the tab open. On mobile, keep the screen on.
By default after every 4 cycles (≈2 hours of work) — 15 minutes long. Use it for lunch or a walk.
Adjust the environment — silence notifications, put your phone away, use headphones with white noise. If even 25 minutes feels too long, start with 15/3 and increase gradually.

trip-split.description: Split travel or dining expenses among members with minimum-transfer settlement. Per-expense partial sharing, greedy optimization.
trip-split.metaDescription: Free trip expense splitter. Dutch pay for groups, fewest transfers, partial shares per expense.
howTo: For each expense, set the amount, who paid, and who shares it.
The settlement (who owes whom) is computed automatically.

faq.q: How is this different from a simple divide-by-N?
faq.a: This tool (1) tracks who paid each expense, (2) lets you set different sharers per expense, (3) outputs the minimum transfer list to settle up. Much more practical than naive division.

faq.q: Why doesn't everyone send to everyone?
faq.a: A greedy algorithm minimizes the number of transfers. 5 people often settle with 2–3 transfers.

faq.q: Someone didn't drink — can I exclude them?
faq.a: Uncheck them from the 'share' list on that specific expense. They won't be charged for it.

faq.q: How do I share the result on KakaoTalk?
faq.a: Screenshot the result or copy the text and paste it in your group chat. The tool just displays it.
No — everything runs in your browser. Refreshing clears the data, so screenshot first if you need to save it.
Single currency only. Convert to your own currency first, or use [exchange rate] alongside.

og-card.description: Generate social-share OG images (1200×630), Instagram squares/vertical, YouTube thumbnails. Title, subtitle, tag, color presets — instant PNG.
og-card.metaDescription: Free OG image generator. 1200×630, blog and social share cards.
howTo: Pick a color preset and size (OG / Instagram / YouTube, etc.).

faq.a: Open Graph image — the preview image shown when a link is shared on Facebook, Twitter, KakaoTalk, etc. The standard size is 1200×630px.
Add it to your blog's HTML with <meta property="og:image" content="...">. It appears as a preview card in search and social shares, significantly boosting click-through rates.
It's the standard Facebook/Twitter ratio — designed to look good on both mobile and desktop. Other sizes get cropped or pixelated.

faq.q: Can I use it for YouTube thumbnails?
faq.a: Pick the 1280×720 size. YouTube thumbnails generally benefit from more visual punch, though — you may want a dedicated design tool.
It auto-uses system fonts (Pretendard, Malgun Gothic, Apple SD Gothic Neo). The actual font depends on the user's OS.

faq.q: Can I use an image background?
faq.a: Solid color and gradient backgrounds only right now. For photo backgrounds, try [image text overlay].

mermaid.description: Draw flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and pie charts from text code. Embed-ready for GitHub README, Notion, Obsidian. Download SVG/PNG.

howTo: Pick a sample to start from.
Edit code on the left — the preview on the right updates live.

faq.a: An open-source tool for drawing diagrams from text. Since you write code instead of clicking, it's easy to version, copy, and edit — popular among developers and technical writers.

Obsidian renders code blocks natively. Notion needs a plugin. The most compatible approach is to export PNG and embed the image.
10+ types — flowchart, sequenceDiagram, gantt, classDiagram, stateDiagram, ER diagram, pie chart, etc.

faq.q: How do I use these in PowerPoint or Keynote?
faq.a: Download as PNG and insert as an image. We export at 2x resolution, so it stays crisp in print.
Mermaid favors quick, clear diagrams. For fully custom designs, look at draw.io, Figma, or Excalidraw.

Download individually or grab the whole batch as a ZIP.

Yes. Set max width and height auto-scales to keep the ratio. Set 0 to keep original size.

faq.q: What if I only have one image?
faq.a: Single-image tools ([image compress], [image resize], [PNG to JPG]) have simpler UIs. Use this when working with many images.

pdf-merge.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one. Drag to reorder, and files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.

Click Merge — it combines them into one PDF.

faq.q: Does the result have a watermark?

faq.a: Page contents transfer as-is, but some external bookmarks and form fields may drop. Digital signatures may become invalid after merging.
Yes, on Android/iOS browsers. Large files may strain mobile memory — a desktop is safer for big jobs.

Original name with page numbers appended (e.g., report_p1-3.pdf).

Page contents are preserved, but internal links to pages outside their split may break.

howTo: Pick the pages to rotate (all or specific).

howTo: Click Process — a new PDF without those pages is created.

faq.a: This tool just embeds images — no OCR. For searchable PDFs, use Adobe Acrobat's OCR or similar.
Drag thumbnails or use the up/down buttons after upload.

pdf-watermark.description: Add a text watermark (e.g., 'CONFIDENTIAL', company name) to every page of a PDF. Adjustable color, opacity, rotation, and size.

faq.a: Most social networks strip EXIF on upload. Photos saved from them rarely have any data left.

color-extract.description: Auto-extract main colors from a photo to create a palette. Great for design inspiration and brand color analysis.

heic-to-jpg.metaDescription: Free HEIC → JPG converter. Fix iPhone photo compatibility, processed safely in your browser.

text-to-speech.metaDescription: Free text-to-speech (TTS). Korean, English, multilingual, adjustable speed and pitch, built-in browser TTS.

num-to-korean.metaDescription: Free number-to-Korean converter. Contract/receipt notation, auto 일금/원정 formatting.
howTo: Choose options like contract or bankbook format.

kor-eng-keyboard.description: Convert 'dkssudgktpdy' (English typed on a Hangul keyboard) to '안녕하세요' instantly. Works both ways. Useful for recovering accidentally typed text, fixing messages sent in the wrong layout to KakaoTalk or forums, and debugging password Korean/English confusion.
kor-eng-keyboard.metaDescription: Free Hangul/English keyboard converter. dkssudgktpdy → 안녕하세요 both ways.

Only the standard 2-set keyboard for now. Sebeolsik users may see different results.

faq.q: Does it work for the Korean phone 'Cheonjiin' layout?

character-counter.description: Count characters, words, and lines in real time. Use for Naver blog, cover letters, papers, college essays, contest entries, newspaper columns, and Twitter/SNS character limits.
character-counter.metaDescription: Free character counter. Includes/excludes spaces, words, byte count, real-time display.
howTo: Paste your text in the input box above.
Character count, count without spaces, words, and lines display live on the right.
Edit until you fit the desired character limit.

faq.q: How does Naver Blog count characters?
faq.a: Naver generally counts characters including spaces. This tool shows both with and without spaces.

faq.q: How do Korean college essays count characters?

Usually 1 character, but some systems count compound emojis (skin tone, ZWJ) as 2–4. Check the actual SNS for exact counts.

text-case.description: Convert text to UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, or CONSTANT_CASE instantly. Useful for renaming code variables, keeping filenames consistent, building URL slugs, CSS class names, and DB column names.
text-case.metaDescription: Free case converter. camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE supported.

camelCase (JS variables), PascalCase (class names), snake_case (Python, DB), kebab-case (URLs, CSS), CONSTANT_CASE (constants).

howTo: Paste text with one item per line.

faq.q: When do I use random shuffle?

lorem-ipsum.metaDescription: Free Lorem Ipsum / Korean filler text generator. Choose word, sentence, or paragraph count.

diff-checker.description: Compare two texts side by side to see additions, deletions, and changes. Useful for code review, document change tracking, contract revision review, translation comparison, suspected plagiarism check, and resume version control.

korean-age.description: Enter your birth date and see Western (international) age, Korean counting age, and yeonnai (year age) at once. korean-age.metaDescription: Free Korean age calculator. Western age, Korean age, and year age at once, based on 2023 law.

faq.a: Age counted by birthday. You're 0 at birth and add 1 each birthday. Since June 2023, this is the official legal age in Korea.
The traditional Korean count — you're 1 at birth and everyone adds 1 each January 1st. Fading after the 2023 standardization.
Current year − birth year. Ignores birthday. Used in some Korean laws like the Drinking Act and Youth Protection Act.

faq.q: Which age applies to military duty and national pension?
faq.a: Military duty uses year age (birth-year based); national pension and basic pension use Western age. Confusing — check carefully.

faq.q: How does this affect workplace titles?
faq.a: Legally it's Western age but everyday conversation and seniority still often follow counting age. The shift will take time.
Legally 60 (Western age) in Korea, though company rules may vary.

lunar-solar.description: Convert Korean lunar and solar dates in both directions. Range 1391–2050, leap month support, and ganji display. Useful for converting your parents' or grandparents' lunar birthdays to solar, ancestral rites date conversion, checking Lunar New Year and Chuseok dates, and entering data for fortune telling.
lunar-solar.metaDescription: Free Korean lunar/solar conversion. Leap month and ganji support, 1391–2050.

faq.a: That's the standard range with accurate Korean lunar calendar data. Beyond this range, astronomical calculations become unreliable.
The lunar year is about 11 days shorter than the solar year, so a month is added every 2–3 years to catch up. That added month is the leap month (윤달).

faq.q: Why do solar and lunar birthdays differ each year?
faq.a: A lunar birthday lands on a different solar date each year. To put your parents' lunar birthday on a solar calendar, you'll need yearly conversion.

faq.q: Are seasonal terms like Hansik or Dongji supported?
faq.a: The 24 solar terms are solar-based and roughly fall on the same date each year — separate from lunar conversion.

faq.q: Is North Korea's lunar calendar the same?
faq.a: South and North Korea both use the same East Asian lunar calendar. China and Vietnam are similar but with subtle differences.

faq.q: My grandparents say they celebrate their lunar birthday on solar X — how?
faq.a: Lunar → solar conversion changes yearly. Either re-enter the new solar date in your calendar each year, or use an app that natively supports lunar dates.

caesar-cipher.description: Encrypt and decrypt text with Caesar cipher. ROT13/ROT47 presets and custom 1–25 rotation. Useful for CTF challenges, hiding spoilers on forums, introductory cryptography study, and fun message encoding.
caesar-cipher.metaDescription: Free Caesar cipher. ROT13/ROT47/custom 1-25 rotation, both directions.

faq.q: Can I use this for real security?
faq.a: Caesar is a trivially broken cipher — use only for jokes, quizzes, and games. Real security needs modern crypto like AES or RSA.
A 13-position Caesar cipher. It's its own inverse — applying twice returns the original. Common for hiding spoilers on forums.
Rotates ASCII 33–126 (letters, numbers, symbols) by 47. Unlike ROT13 (letters only), it covers almost all printable characters.

faq.q: What if I don't know the rotation?
faq.a: Use the ROT All tool to see all rotations 1–25 at once. Handy for CTF and puzzles.
Korean has 24 jamo, so Caesar isn't well-defined. This tool focuses on English letters and numbers.
Named after Julius Caesar, who used a 3-position rotation for military messages in ancient Rome.

http-status.description: Search the meaning of HTTP response codes 100–599. RFC standard codes plus common non-standard ones (418, 429, etc.). Useful for API debugging, error screen analysis, backend response design, interview prep, and web dev study.
http-status.metaDescription: Free HTTP status code reference. 200/301/404/500 meanings and usage examples.
howTo: Search by code number or keyword.
Each code's meaning and usage example are displayed.

faq.a: RFC 9110 standard codes plus common non-standard ones (418 I'm a teapot, 429 Too Many Requests, etc.).
2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client error, 5xx server error. Generally, 4xx is the user/request, 5xx is the server itself.
401 (Unauthorized) means no authentication (login required); 403 (Forbidden) means authenticated but no permission. Don't confuse them.
404 is the most user-visible error, but 502/503/504 gateway errors are more painful operationally.

Fine from HTTP's perspective, but business logic may treat empty as a problem. Check the body too, not just the code.

135° (top-left → bottom-right) is the most natural and common. 90° (left→right) and 180° (top→bottom) are also clean.
Adjust each color stop's alpha (rgba). Useful for dark overlay over text.

base-converter.description: Convert between decimal, binary, octal, and hex instantly. Negatives and decimals supported, with auto-digit grouping. Useful for coding/CS study, color code (#RRGGBB) analysis, IP address conversion, bitwise op debugging, and assembly learning.

Linux file permissions (755, 644, etc.) and escape characters (\077). Rare in everyday coding.
Electrical signals ON/OFF map naturally to 0/1. Ternary or higher bases are theoretically possible but less reliable in practice.
Stable up to JavaScript's safe integer (2^53). Beyond that, BigInt mode or a dedicated tool is needed.

html-entity.description: Convert special characters like &, <, >, ", ' to HTML entities (&, <, >) and back. Numeric entities for Korean and emoji are also supported. Useful for safely displaying code samples on blogs, XSS prevention, writing HTML emails, and validating sitemaps and RSS feeds.
html-entity.metaDescription: Free HTML entity encoder/decoder. Converts & < > " ', supports numeric entities (Korean, emoji).
howTo: Enter text and pick the direction.

faq.q: Why are entities so common in HTML email?
faq.a: Email clients handle encoding differently, so converting all special characters to entities in advance is a safety practice.

faq.q: Why does decoded text look broken?
faq.a: Could be double-encoded (entities encoded twice) or invalid entity numbers.

password-strength.metaDescription: Free password strength check. Length, character types, common pattern analysis, instant score.
howTo: Strength score and improvement suggestions appear live.

(1) 12+ characters, (2) mix of upper/lower/numbers/symbols, (3) no dictionary words or keyboard patterns, (4) not reused across sites.

color-contrast.description: Calculate contrast ratio between text and background and check WCAG AA/AAA compliance. Useful for design accessibility audits, government and public sector sites (accessibility required), accommodating visually impaired users, and mobile readability checks.
color-contrast.metaDescription: Free WCAG color contrast check. Ratio, AA/AAA pass status, preview.
